vulnerability_title: [M-09] GTL contract is vulnerable to an inflation attack

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Use one of the provide methods inside the solady ERC4626 contract:

1. Decimal offset
2. Virtual shares
3. Fixed initial conversion rate when minting shares

[View detailed Proof of Concept](https://code4rena.com/audits/2025-08-gte-perps-and-launchpad/submissions/F-177)
